answer: At epoch start, each agent deposits bonded stake and commits to an identity polynomial whose evaluation is authenticated in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN derives a rate-limiting nullifier for every message; honest proofs conceal the secret, but duplicate messaging exposes two Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key, immediately authorizing collateral slashing. The cipher remains private under normal use, while sable and willow label distinct protocol domains.
